title: China's AI labs: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and the open-model race
dek: Cheap, open models from DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot and Zhipu closed much of the gap with US labs, and sparked accusations of copying.
seoTitle: Chinese AI models 2025–2026: DeepSeek V4, Qwen, Kimi
bigLabel: Near-frontier releases from five Chinese firms between June and August 2026, per State Street Global Advisors

glance.what: DeepSeek's R1 shook the industry in January 2025. In 2026 Chinese labs released a wave of large open-weight models, including DeepSeek V4, Moonshot's Kimi K3, Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max and Zhipu's GLM-5.2, often far cheaper than US rivals.
glance.why: Open, cheap models let anyone build AI products without paying US companies, and they sit at the centre of the US–China technology contest.
glance.next: Alibaba says Qwen 4 is coming 'very soon', and DeepSeek has confirmed a V4.1 Pro, without dates.

forYou: Chinese models are free to download and run, and some apps you use may be built on them. Their chatbots follow Chinese content rules, which shape answers on some political topics.
next: Qwen 4 and DeepSeek V4.1 Pro, both undated.

events.title: DeepSeek's R1 shock
events.summary: DeepSeek releases its chatbot built on the R1 reasoning model, matching larger US rivals at far lower cost and rattling markets.

events.title: Kimi K2.6 and Qwen 3.6
events.summary: Moonshot releases Kimi K2.6 on 20 April, and Alibaba releases its Qwen 3.6 models under an open licence the same month.

events.title: DeepSeek V4
events.summary: After months of delays, DeepSeek launches V4 and V4 Pro, a 1.6-trillion-parameter open model, a day after OpenAI's GPT-5.5.

events.title: GLM-5.2 opens a summer wave
events.summary: Zhipu's Z.ai releases GLM-5.2, briefly the top open model.

events.title: Kimi K3
events.summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3 becomes the leading open-weight model; sign-ups pause when it runs out of chips. Weights follow on 27 July.

events.title: Qwen3.8-Max
events.summary: Alibaba releases the cloud version of its 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8-Max, and says big commercial users of its next open model will need a revenue-sharing deal.

events.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro, and price rises
events.summary: DeepSeek's V4 Pro becomes generally available, and it raises V4 API prices with peak and off-peak rates, Reuters reports.

events.title: Copying accusation; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
events.summary: Anthropic accuses seven Chinese labs of harvesting about 190 million Claude responses to train their models. The same day DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash on a new design and cuts prices.

events.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash update
events.summary: A checkpoint update with the same price and an improved coding score, per DeepSeek's own tests.

events.title: ByteDance: frontier parity by 2029–30
events.summary: ByteDance plans a Meta Muse-style assistant within weeks, and co-founder Zhang Yiming tells staff catching OpenAI and Anthropic will not happen before 2029 or 2030, Bloomberg reports.
